g.text: Capacity losses along the observed early trajectories
Campaign 020 retrospective replay: all 60 worlds, including any empty-world ticks.
Segments connect two different-denominator summaries for the same world; they are not confidence intervals.
Conditional expectations use observed stocks. Neither quantity isolates a causal effect on survival.
